attributes.name: Dusk-Taker
attributes.powers:
When you examine this card, encounter it.

Before you act, succeed at an Intelligence or Perception 10 check or Dusk-Taker is immune to the Melee trait and the difficulty to defeat is increased by 4.

"Hakotep kept the ancient roc Kenjuret as a pet. This is a story about keeping your pets at home while you experiment with magic." –Erayu
